title: stachys grayana
intro: Stachys grayana, commonly known as Gray's Betony, is a type of flowering plant in the mint family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including the relief of anxiety, insomnia, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Stachys grayana are attributed to its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of the plant include triterpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
